_fiscal_year_note: The three-year window is PER COMPANY. ZTE/POPMART are calendar-year filers -> 2023/2024/2025. NVIDIA's fiscal year ends in late January of the next calendar year (FY2026 ended 2026-01-25), so as of the cutoff its latest three reported fiscal years are FY2024/FY2025/FY2026. An override must use these same year keys — the calculator's frozen per-company FISCAL_YEARS decides which keys are read, and unmatched years surface as self-check failures.
rounding: net_profit/inventory -> 2 decimals; roe -> 2 decimals of percent
